shows.title: I'm Every Woman
shows.description: Get ready to witness the incredible untold life story and music of multi-platinum selling, 10-time GRAMMY® winner and global icon, Chaka Khan! With 22 albums, 25 chart-topping hits, 70 million records sold and a career spanning five decades, Chaka Khan has shaped the sound of generations. Now, her story explodes onto stage starring Alexandra Burke (Sister Act, The Bodyguard, Chicago, The X Factor winner 2008) for a limited season at London’s Troubadour Wembley Park Theatre.

shows.title: Mother Courage and Her Children - Globe
shows.description: Shakespeare’s Globe welcomes revolutionary playwright Brecht to the stage for the very first time with a new production of his anti-war masterpiece, Mother Courage and Her Children.

shows.title: Much Ado About Nothing - Globe
shows.description: Sharp tongues and savage gossip fuel a messy, magnetic attraction in this new production of Shakespeare’s Much Ado About Nothing in the Globe Theatre.
